description: The RSS and Atom feeds the WORKSPACE reads (forums, communities, blogs): every keyword with readsWorkspaceFeeds (the default) gets an item of one of these feeds as a mention when the item holds its term, with its matching rules, billed like any mention. Each feed with when it was connected and how its hourly poll goes. q filters on address or title; limit and offset page, total counts.

limit.description: Feeds per page, at most 500; default 100.

offset.description: Feeds to skip, for the next page.

q.description: Only feeds whose address or title contains this text, case-insensitive.

name: list_feeds
title: List feeds
